pirs.question: Will the Tidö coalition maintain its +1 seat majority through the May 2026 legislative session?
pirs.answer: Yes — voting discipline strong, no defection signals. FI-01/FI-02 forward indicators to confirm.

pirs.question: Will the HD01JuU10 weapons law pass with its current provisions intact?
pirs.answer: Very likely — only hunting community provisions may see amendment pressure.

pirs.question: Will S's sick-pay interpellation produce a ministerial commitment to revisit the day-180 ceiling?
pirs.answer: Unlikely — government will defend Tidö agreement implementation. Monitor FI-03.

pirs.question: Will Södra stambanan receive a funding commitment in May 2026?
pirs.answer: Unlikely before election. Government likely to defer to post-election infrastructure plan. Monitor FI-04, FI-15.

pirs.question: Will HD03231/HD03232 Ukraine ratifications pass with bipartisan support?
pirs.answer: Near-certain near-consensus. S, M, C, L, KD, MP all supportive. SD likely Ja.

pirs.question: Will polling in May 2026 show Tidö coalition maintaining ≥175 seats?
pirs.answer: Current estimates marginal. FI-06 (June polling) is the key indicator.

pirs.question: Will the Centre Party (C) signal a post-election coalition preference before summer 2026?
pirs.answer: C typically avoids pre-election coalition commitments. Most likely to emerge in August (FI-13).
